29700.meaning1: practising like that; conducting oneself thus; following that path
29700.commentary: (VISMa) tathāpaṭipanno'ti yathā samathavipassanāsukhaṃ āvahati, yathā vā satthārā anusiṭṭhaṃ, tathā paṭipanno sāsanadhammo.

examples.text: so jarāmaraṇañ'ca pajānāti jarāmaraṇasamudayañ'ca pajānāti jarāmaraṇanirodhañ'ca pajānāti yā ca jarāmaraṇanirodhasāruppagāminī paṭipadā tañ'ca pajānāti. tathāpaṭipanno ca hoti anudhammacārī.

29701.meaning1: ordained like that; renounced in such a manner

examples.text: te tathāpabbajitā samānā ekā vūpakaṭṭhā appamattā ātāpino pahit'attā viharantā nacirass'eva, yass'atthāya kulaputtā samma'd'eva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ, brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharanti.
vuṭṭhahi c'āyasmā mahākassapo tamhā ābādhā. tathāpahīno c'āyasmato mahākassapassa so ābādho ahosī'ti.

29706.meaning1: of such nature; of such quality; just like that

examples.text: so evaṃ pajānāti, tathābhūto kho ayaṃ kāyo yathābhūtasmiṃ kāye pāṇisamphassā'pi kamanti, leḍḍusamphassā'pi kamanti, daṇḍasamphassā'pi kamanti, satthasamphassā'pi kamanti.
yaṃ tathābhūtassa rūpaṃ taṃ rūp'upādānakkhandhe saṅgahaṃ gacchati, yā tathābhūtassa vedanā sā vedan'upādānakkhandhe saṅgahaṃ gacchati

29707.meaning2: in this way; likewise it become; as it is

examples.text: kiṃ nu kho ahaṃ añña'd'atthu bhayapaṭikaṅkhī viharāmi? yaṃnūn'āhaṃ yathābhūtaṃ yathābhūtassa me taṃ bhayabheravaṃ āgacchati, tathābhūtaṃ tathābhūtova taṃ bhayabheravaṃ paṭivineyyan'ti

atha puriso āgaccheyya ghamm'ābhitatto ghammapareto kilanto tasito pipāsito ek'āyanena maggena tam'eva aṅgārakāsuṃ paṇidhāya. tam'enaṃ cakkhumā puriso disvā evaṃ vadeyya, tath'āyaṃ bhavaṃ puriso paṭipanno tathā ca iriyati tañ'ca maggaṃ samārūḷho, yathā imaṃ'y'eva aṅgārakāsuṃ āgamissatī'ti.

29709.meaning1: such; such kind; of such quality; so formed

examples.text: attadantassa posassa, niccaṃ saññatacārino, n'eva devo na gandhabbo, na māro saha brahmunā, jitaṃ apajitaṃ kayirā, tathārūpassa jantuno.
tathārūpā'ssa dhammā bahussutā honti dhātā vacasā paricitā manas'ānupekkhitā diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā.

29711.synonym: anukūla, anucchavi, anucchavika, anuloma, anulomika, upiya, kappa, tajja, tadanurūpa, paṭirūpa, patirūpa, patirūpaka, patirūpī, pattayutta, yuttaka, yuttarūpa, sampanna, sāmaggiya, sāruppa

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu uyyuttaṃ senaṃ dassanāya gaccheyya aññatra tathārūpappaccayā, pācittiyaṃ.
yo pana bhikkhu santaṃ bhikkhuṃ anāpucchā vikāle gāmaṃ paviseyya aññatra tathārūpā accāyikā karaṇīyā, pācittiyaṃ.

29712.meaning1: suitable reason; appropriate cause; good reason

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu uyyuttaṃ senaṃ dassanāya gaccheyya aññatra tathārūpappaccayā, pācittiyaṃ.
yo pana bhikkhu agilāno visibban'āpekkho jotiṃ samādaheyya vā samādahāpeyya vā aññatra tathārūpappaccayā, pācittiyaṃ.
anāpatti tathāsaññī codeti vā codāpeti vā, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

29714.commentary: (ANa) tathāsantā'ti yathā santā eva aviparīta-byādhi-ādi-sabhāvā'va hutvā'ti attho.

examples.text: ehi tvaṃ tāta ambaṭṭha, yena samaṇo gotamo ten'upasaṅkama, upasaṅkamitvā samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ jānāhi, yadi vā taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ tathāsantaṃy'eva saddo abbhuggato, yadi vā no tathā.
byādhidhammā jarādhammā, atho maraṇadhammino, yathādhammā tathāsantā, jigucchanti puthujjanā.

29715.meaning1: thus composed; thus centred; thus settled

examples.text: so tathāsamāhitaṃ cittaṃ sādhukaṃ ajjhupekkhitā hoti

29716.meaning1: of such a view; who speaks like that
29716.commentary: (VIN 2.5.7.9) tathāvādinā'ti, tath'āhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi, yathā ye'me antarāyikā dhammā vuttā bhagavatā, te paṭisevato n'ālaṃ antarāyāyā'ti evaṃ vādinā.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ tathāvādinā bhikkhunā akaṭ'ānudhammena taṃ diṭṭhiṃ appaṭinissaṭṭhena saddhiṃ sambhuñjeyya vā saṃvaseyya vā saha vā seyyaṃ kappeyya, pācittiyaṃ.

29717.meaning1: who tells the exact truth; who tells is like it is; truth speaker

examples.text: taṃ tathāvādiniṃ buddho, mamaṃ so etadabravi, na h'evaṃ vandiyā buddhā, yathā vandasi gotamī.

29718.meaning1: of such character; of such quality; such a kind of

examples.text: yo ca tesaṃ tattha tattha, jānāti anudhammataṃ, catupañhassa kusalo, āhu bhikkhuṃ tathāvidhaṃ.
vibhūtarūpasaññissa, sabbakāyappahāyino, ajjhattañ'ca bahiddhā ca, n'atthi kiñcī'ti passato, ñāṇaṃ sakk'ānupucchāmi, kathaṃ neyyo tathāvidho.

29719.meaning1: who is liberated in such way; who is free like this

examples.text: taṃ ce hi n'āddakkhuṃ tathāvimuttaṃ, devā manussā idha vā huraṃ vā, nar'uttamaṃ atthacaraṃ narānaṃ, ye taṃ namassanti pasaṃsiyā te'ti.
pasaṃsiyā te'pi bhavanti bhikkhū, ye taṃ namassanti tathāvimuttaṃ, aññāya dhammaṃ vicikicchaṃ pahāya, saṅg'ātigā te'pi bhavanti bhikkhū'ti.

29720.meaning1: secluded like that; withdrawn in such a way

examples.text: tassa tathāvūpakaṭṭhassa viharato satthā'pi upavadati, anuvicca'pi viññū sabrahmacārī upavadanti, devatā'pi upavadanti, attā'pi attānaṃ upavadati.

29721.meaning1: like I; as I; such as I

examples.text: tath'āhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā ye'me antarāyikā dhammā vuttā bhagavatā te paṭisevato n'ālaṃ antarāyāyā'ti.
tath'āhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi, yathā khīṇ'āsavo bhikkhu kāyassa bhedā ucchijjati vinassati, na hoti paraṃ maraṇā'ti.

29722.commentary: (NIDD1) sabb'eva vādā tathiyā bhaveyyun'ti sabb'eva vādā tathā tacchā bhūtā yāthāvā aviparītā bhaveyyun'ti, sabb'eva vādā tathiyā bhaveyyuṃ.

examples.text: saddhammapūjā'pi nesaṃ tath'eva, yathā pasaṃsanti sak'āyanāni, sabb'eva vādā tathiyā bhaveyyuṃ, suddhī hi nesaṃ paccattam'eva.
na v'āham'etaṃ tathiyan'ti brūmi, yam'āhu bālā mithu aññam'aññaṃ, sakaṃ sakaṃ diṭṭhim'akaṃsu saccaṃ, tasmā hi bālo'ti paraṃ dahanti.

29724.meaning1: comparable in the same way; similar to that; like this

examples.text: yath'indakhīlo pathavissito siyā, catubbhi vātehi asampakampiyo, tath'ūpamaṃ sappurisaṃ vadāmi, yo ariyasaccāni avecca passati, idam'pi saṅghe ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, matajaṃ nāma āvudhajātaṃ ubhatodhāraṃ pītanisitaṃ. tadassa saṅghāṭiyā sampārutaṃ sampaliveṭhitaṃ. tath'ūpama-ahaṃ, bhikkhave, imassa bhikkhuno pabbajjaṃ vadāmi.

29725.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of tathūpama
29725.meaning1: like that; in the same way; similarly
29725.meaning2: like that; in a similar way

examples.text: sele yathā pabbatamuddhaniṭṭhito, yathā'pi passe janataṃ samantato, tath'ūpamaṃ dhammamayaṃ sumedha, pāsādam'āruyha samantacakkhu.

29726.meaning1: comparable in the same way I

examples.text: seyyathā'pi so, bhikkhave, assakhaḷuṅko, pehī'ti vutto, viddho samāno codito sārathinā pacchā laṅghati, kubbaraṃ hanati, tidaṇḍaṃ bhañjati, tath'ūpam'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, imaṃ puggalaṃ vadāmi.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, matajaṃ nāma āvudhajātaṃ ubhatodhāraṃ pītanisitaṃ. tadassa saṅghāṭiyā sampārutaṃ sampaliveṭhitaṃ. tath'ūpam'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, imassa bhikkhuno pabbajjaṃ vadāmi.

29727.meaning1: likewise; in the same way; as it is; as they are; similarly
29727.meaning2: in the same way, likewise, similarly

examples.text: yathā ekam'etaṃ akusalaṃ, samucchindetha paṇḍito, tath'eva dhamme sikkhetha, mā no dummaṅku'yaṃ ahu.
saddhammapūjā'pi nesaṃ tath'eva, yathā pasaṃsanti sak'āyanāni, sabb'eva vādā tathiyā bhaveyyuṃ, suddhī hi nesaṃ paccattam'eva.

29729.meaning1: just like this; simply the truth; how it is

examples.text: tatra, sunakkhatta, ye te bhikkhū samma'd'eva aññaṃ byākaṃsu tesaṃ taṃ tath'eva hoti
jānāmi passāmi tath'eva etaṃ, diṭṭhiyā eke paccenti suddhiṃ, addakkhi ce kiñ'hi tumassa tena, atisitvā aññena vadanti suddhiṃ.

29730.meaning1: just the same; exactly the same; identical

examples.text: saccaṃ, āvuso, bhagavatā sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ. tañ'ca kho gāme, no araññe'ti. nanu, āvuso, tath'ev'etaṃ hoti.

29731.grammar: pron, in comps, nt nom & acc sg of ta

examples.text: yadattanī passati ānisaṃsaṃ, diṭṭhe sute sīlavate mute vā, tadeva so tattha samuggahāya, nihīnato passati sabbam'aññaṃ.
yatha'y'idaṃ brahmacariyaṃ addhaniyaṃ assa ciraṭṭhitikaṃ, tad'assa bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lok'ānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ

29732.meaning1: that is inappropriate; that is unsuitable (to say)
29732.meaning2: that is inappropriate; that is unsuitable

examples.text: yāvatā, ānanda, adhivacanaṃ yāvatā adhivacanapatho, yāvatā nirutti yāvatā niruttipatho, yāvatā paññatti yāvatā paññattipatho, yāvatā paññā yāvatā paññ'āvacaraṃ, yāvatā vaṭṭaṃ, yāvatā vaṭṭati, tadabhiññāvimutto bhikkhu, tadabhiññāvimuttaṃ bhikkhuṃ na jānāti na passati iti'ssa diṭṭhī'ti, tadakallaṃ.

29733.meaning1: beginning from that; from that day onwards; since then; henceforth
29733.commentary: (DNa) tadagge'ti taṃ aggaṃ katvā, tato paṭṭhāyā'ti attho. (DNa) tadagge… taṃdivasaṃ ādiṃ katvā

examples.text: tadagge kho pana ambaṭṭha sakyā paññāyanti, so ca nesaṃ pubbapuriso.

29734.meaning2: according to that; to that extent

29735.meaning2: substitution of opposites (function of insight in substituting, e.g. perception of impermanence for perception of permanence)

29736.meaning1: in that respect; regarding that; in that aspect

examples.text: tesaṃ pahānā na paritassati, aparitassaṃ sukhaṃ viharati, sukhavihārī bhikkhu tadaṅganibbuto'ti vuccatī'ti.

29739.meaning1: quenched in that regard; emancipated in that aspect; cooled in that respect
29739.commentary: (SNa) tadaṅganibbuto'ti tena vipassan'aṅgena kilesānaṃ nibbutattā tadaṅganibbuto. imasmiṃ sutte vipassanā'va kathitā.

examples.text: tesaṃ pahānā na paritassati, aparitassaṃ sukhaṃ viharati, sukhavihārī bhikkhu tadaṅganibbuto'ti vuccatī'ti.

29740.meaning1: escape by substitution of the opposite factor

29741.meaning1: liberation by (elimination of the opposite of) that factor

examples.text: anicc'ānupassan'ādikā satt'ānupassanā sayaṃ tassa tassa paccanīk'aṅgavasena pariccattāhi niccasaññ'ādīhi vimuttattā tadaṅgavimuttī'ti saṅkhyaṃ gacchanti.

29742.grammar: ind, adv, comp, instr sg of tadaṅga
29742.meaning1: in that respect; by that means; in that regard; with that quality

examples.text: yattha kāmā nirujjhanti, ye ca kāme nirodhetvā nirodhetvā viharanti, addhā te āyasmanto nicchātā nibbutā tiṇṇā pāraṅ'gatā tadaṅgenā'ti vadāmi

29743.meaning1: that today I; that now I

examples.text: idaṃ pure cittam'acāri cārikaṃ, yen'icchakaṃ yatthakāmaṃ yathāsukhaṃ, tadajj'ahaṃ niggahessāmi yoniso, hatthippabhinnaṃ viya aṅkusaggaho.

29744.meaning1: got that; obtained that; achieved that; (comm) then got
29744.commentary: (JAa) adassanaṃ'y'eva tadajjhagamā'ti tato paṭṭhāya adassanam'eva gato'ti. (VINt) tadā ajjhagamā tadajjhagamā.

examples.text: pathavīdhātuy'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, assādapariyesanaṃ acariṃ, yo pathavīdhātuyā assādo tadajjhagamaṃ, yāvatā pathavīdhātuyā assādo paññāya me so sudiṭṭho. pathavīdhātuy'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, ādīnavapariyesanaṃ acariṃ, yo pathavīdhātuyā ādīnavo tadajjhagamaṃ, yāvatā pathavīdhātuyā ādīnavo paññāya me so sudiṭṭho.
na taṃ yāce yassa piyaṃ jigīse [jigiṃse], desso hoti atiyācanāya, nāgo maṇiṃ yācito brāhmaṇena, adassanaṃ'y'eva tadajjhagamā'ti.
evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, yam'idaṃ dhammasamādānaṃ paccuppannasukhañ'c'eva āyatiñ'ca sukhavipākaṃ tadaññe puthusamaṇabrāhmaṇaparappavāde abhivihacca bhāsate ca tapate ca virocate cā'ti.

29747.meaning1: that commentary; that explanation of the meaning; commentary of that (sutta)

examples.text: iti samaggānaṃ vā bhettā [bhedakā (ka.), bhedetā (syā. kaṃ.), tadaṭṭhakathāyaṃ pana bhettā'ti dissati], bhinnānaṃ vā anuppadātā, vagg'ārāmo vaggarato vagganandī vaggakaraṇiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti.

29748.commentary: (DNt) tadattāyā'ti taṃbhāvāya, yathārūpesu khandhesu pavattamānesu devā gandhabbā'ti lokasamaññā hoti, tathārūpatāyā'ti attho.

examples.text: jāti ca hi, ānanda, n'ābhavissa sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ kassaci kimhici, seyyath'idaṃ… catuppadānaṃ vā catuppadattāya, pakkhīnaṃ vā pakkhittāya, sarīsapānaṃ vā sarīsapattāya, tesaṃ tesañ'ca hi, ānanda, sattānaṃ tadattāya jāti n'ābhavissa.
[etth'antare pāṭho idha nadissati, catukk'aṅg'uttare pana imasmiṃ ṭhāne dissati, aṭṭhakathāṭīkāsu ca tadattho pakāsito. tasmā so ettha paṭīpūrito]

29750.grammar: ind, adv, comp, dat sg of tadattha
29750.meaning1: for that purpose; towards that goal

examples.text: santi ca kho, anuruddhā, kulaputtā saddhā uḷāravedā uḷārapāmojjā. te taṃ sutvā tadatthāya cittaṃ upasaṃharanti. tesaṃ taṃ, anuruddhā, hoti dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya.

29751.meaning1: that has vanished; that has disappeared

examples.text: yadaniccaṃ taṃ dukkhaṃ, yaṃ dukkhaṃ taṃ niruddhaṃ tadatthaṅ'gatan'ti. evaṃ puṭṭho'haṃ, āvuso, evaṃ byākareyyan'ti.

29752.commentary: (DNa) tadatthajotakan'ti khajjabhojj'ādi-jotakaṃ, tesaṃ lābhasaṃvattanikan'ti attho. (DNt) tadatthajotakan'ti vā tassa paṇītabhojana-dāyakatta-saṅkhātassa atthassa jotakaṃ.

examples.text: byākaṃsu veyyañjanikā samāgatā, samappatiṭṭhassa na hoti khambhanā, gihissa vā pabbajitassa vā puna, taṃ lakkhaṇaṃ bhavati tadatthajotakaṃ.

29753.meaning1: explaining the meaning of that; (or) illuminating that goal

examples.text: etadavocā'ti etaṃ gāthābandhaṃ avoca. gāthā ca nām'etā tadatthadīpanā'pi honti vises'atthadīpanā'pi, tatr'imā tadattham'pi vises'attham'pi dīpenti'y'eva. tattha khattiyan'ti khettānaṃ adhipatiṃ.

29754.meaning1: explanation of the meaning of that

29755.meaning2: for that purpose; for the sake of

29757.meaning1: focused on that; intent on that; devoted to that

examples.text: so tadassādeti, taṃ nikāmeti, tena ca vittiṃ āpajjati. tattha ṭhito tadadhimutto tabbahulavihārī aparihīno kālaṃ kurumāno brahmakāyikānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjati.

29758.meaning1: that is non-self; that is not oneself
29758.commentary: (MNt) yaṃ tan'ti kāraṇaniddeso'v'āyaṃ, yasmā rūpaṃ aniccaṃ, taṃ tasmā'ti attho. yaṃ dukkhaṃ tadanattā'ti ettha vuttanayen'eva attho veditabbo.

examples.text: yadaniccaṃ taṃ dukkhaṃ, yaṃ dukkhaṃ tadanattā, yadanattā taṃ n'etaṃ mama, n'eso'ham'asmi, na m'eso attā'ti evam'etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.

29759.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of tadantara
29759.meaning1: subsequently; just after that; immediately following that

examples.text: paraṃ maraṇā'ti tadanantaraṃ abhinibbattakkhandhaggahaṇe. athavā kāyassa bhedā'ti jīvit'indriyass'upacchedā. paraṃ maraṇā'ti cuticittato uddhaṃ.

29760.meaning1: that is impermanent; that is unstable

examples.text: so iti paṭisañcikkhati, idam'pi paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ abhisaṅkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ. yaṃ kho pana kiñci abhisaṅkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ tadaniccaṃ nirodhadhamman'ti pajānāti.

29761.commentary: (DNa) tadanugāyantī'ti eta'r'ahi brāhmaṇā taṃ tehi pubbe gītaṃ anugāyanti anusajjhāyanti.

examples.text: kiṃ pana, bhāradvāja, ye'pi te brāhmaṇānaṃ pubbakā isayo mantānaṃ kattāro mantānaṃ pavattāro yesam'idaṃ eta'r'ahi brāhmaṇā porāṇaṃ mantapadaṃ gītaṃ pavuttaṃ samihitaṃ tadanugāyanti tadanubhāsanti bhāsitam'anubhāsanti vācitam'anuvācenti

29763.meaning1: about what is suitable; regarding what is proper; about what is appropriate
29763.commentary: (VINa) bhikkhūnaṃ tadanucchavikaṃ tadanulomikan'ti tattha sannipatitānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ yaṃ idāni sikkhāpadaṃ paññapessati, tassa anucchavikañ'c'eva anulomikañ'ca. yo vā ayaṃ subharat'ādīhi saṃvaro vutto, tassa anucchavikañ'c'eva anulomikañ'ca saṃvarappahānapaṭisaṃyuttaṃ asutt'antavinibaddhaṃ pāḷivinimuttaṃ okkantikadhammadesanaṃ katvā'ti attho.

examples.text: atha kho so bhikkhu eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahit'atto viharanto nacirass'eva, yass'atthāya kulaputtā samma'd'eva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.

29765.meaning1: that unsurpassed goal of the spiritual path
29765.commentary: (MNa) tadanuttaran'ti taṃ anuttaraṃ. brahmacariyapariyosānan'ti maggabrahmacariyassa pariyosānaṃ, arahattaphalan'ti vuttaṃ hoti. tassa hi atthāya kulaputtā pabbajanti.

examples.text: tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi.

29766.meaning1: and according to that; and in line with that; and along those lines

examples.text: so evaṃ pajānāti, imañ'ce ahaṃ upekkhaṃ evaṃ parisuddhaṃ evaṃ pariyodātaṃ ākās'ānañc'āyatanaṃ upasaṃhareyyaṃ, tadanudhammañ'ca cittaṃ bhāveyyaṃ, evaṃ me ayaṃ upekkhā taṃnissitā tadupādānā ciraṃ dīgham'addhānaṃ tiṭṭheyya.
lok'āmis'ādhimuttassa kho, sunakkhatta, purisapuggalassa tappatirūpī c'eva kathā saṇṭhāti, tadanudhammañ'ca anuvitakketi, anuvicāreti, tañ'ca purisaṃ bhajati, tena ca vittiṃ āpajjati

kiṃ pana, bhāradvāja, ye'pi te brāhmaṇānaṃ pubbakā isayo mantānaṃ kattāro mantānaṃ pavattāro yesam'idaṃ eta'r'ahi brāhmaṇā porāṇaṃ mantapadaṃ gītaṃ pavuttaṃ samihitaṃ tadanugāyanti tadanubhāsanti bhāsitam'anubhāsanti vācitam'anuvācenti

29768.synonym: anukūla, anucchavi, anucchavika, anuloma, upiya, kappa, tajja, tathārūpa, paṭirūpa, patirūpa, patirūpaka, patirūpī, pattayutta, yuttaka, yuttarūpa, sāmaggiya, sāruppa

examples.text: atha kho candanaṅgaliko upāsako bhagavato sammukhā tadanurūpāya gāthāya abhitthavi

29769.meaning1: about what is suitable; regarding what is proper; about what is appropriate
29769.commentary: (VINa) bhikkhūnaṃ tadanucchavikaṃ tadanulomikan'ti tattha sannipatitānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ yaṃ idāni sikkhāpadaṃ paññapessati, tassa anucchavikañ'c'eva anulomikañ'ca. yo vā ayaṃ subharat'ādīhi saṃvaro vutto, tassa anucchavikañ'c'eva anulomikañ'ca saṃvarappahānapaṭisaṃyuttaṃ asutt'antavinibaddhaṃ pāḷivinimuttaṃ okkantikadhammadesanaṃ katvā'ti attho.

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, tadanussarato evaṃ hoti, bahūnaṃ vata no bhagavā dukkhadhammānaṃ apahattā, bahūnaṃ vata no bhagavā sukhadhammānaṃ upahattā, bahūnaṃ vata no bhagavā akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ apahattā, bahūnaṃ vata no bhagavā kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upahattā'ti.

29772.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of tadantara
29772.meaning1: for so long; for that time; for that interval
29772.commentary: (DNa) tadantaraṃ paṭisallīnā'ti tadantaraṃ paṭisallīnā sampati paṭisallīnā vā. tasmā na kevalaṃ jhāyī jhānaratāti durupasaṅkamā, idānim'eva paṭisallīnā'ti'pi durupasaṅkamā. (ANa) tadantaran'ti taṃ antaraṃ khaṇaṃ okāsaṃ.

examples.text: atha kho sakko devānam'indo pañcasikhaṃ gandhabbadevaputtaṃ āmantesi, durupasaṅkamā kho, tāta pañcasikha, tathāgatā mādisena, jhāyī jhānaratā, tadantaraṃ paṭisallīnā.

yathā kathaṃ pana tvaṃ, bhikkhu, bhāvesi maraṇassatin'ti? idha mayhaṃ, bhante, evaṃ hoti, aho vat'āhaṃ tadantaraṃ jīveyyaṃ yadantaraṃ ekapiṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjāmi, bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasi kareyyaṃ, bahu vata me kataṃ assā'ti. evaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhante, bhāvemi maraṇassatin'ti.

29773.meaning1: (gram) elision of the end of that

29774.meaning1: following that; emulating that; conforming to that

examples.text: katamassa ekassa paññ'indriyassa paññavato, bhikkhave, ariyasāvakassa tadanvayā saddhā saṇṭhāti, tadanvayaṃ vīriyaṃ saṇṭhāti, tadanvayā sati saṇṭhāti, tadanvayo samādhi saṇṭhāti.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, ambapiṇḍiyā vaṇṭacchinnāya yāni tattha ambāni vaṇṭapaṭibandhāni sabbāni tāni tadanvayāni bhavanti
tatr'āvuso, ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā sayaṃkataṃ sukhadukkhaṃ paññapenti, tadapi phassapaccayā.
yadapi, bhikkhave, alobho tadapi kusalamūlaṃ. yadapi aluddho abhisaṅkharoti kāyena vācāya manasā tadapi kusalaṃ.

29776.meaning1: that unestablished; that ungrounded; that unsupported

examples.text: tadappatiṭṭhitaṃ viññāṇaṃ avirūḷhaṃ anabhisaṅkhacca vimuttaṃ. vimuttattā ṭhitaṃ. ṭhitattā santusitaṃ. santusitattā na paritassati. aparitassaṃ paccattaññ'eva parinibbāyati.

29778.meaning1: directly knowing that; personally understanding that; directly realizing that

examples.text: tadabhiññā ācikkhiṃ bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ upāsakānaṃ upāsikānaṃ.

29779.meaning1: directly knowing that; personally understanding that; directly realizing that

examples.text: te tadabhiññāya tassa sacchikiriyāya dhammaṃ desenti. evaṃvādino'pi kho, bhikkhave, santi sattā. evaṃvādīnam'pi kho, bhikkhave, sattānaṃ atth'eva aññathattaṃ atthi vipariṇāmo.

pathaviṃ kho ahaṃ, brahme, pathavito abhiññāya yāvatā pathaviyā pathavattena ananubhūtaṃ tadabhiññāya pathaviṃ n'āp'ahosiṃ, pathaviyā n'āp'ahosiṃ, pathavito n'āp'ahosiṃ, pathaviṃ me'ti n'āp'ahosiṃ, pathaviṃ n'ābhivadiṃ.

yāvatā, ānanda, adhivacanaṃ yāvatā adhivacanapatho, yāvatā nirutti yāvatā niruttipatho, yāvatā paññatti yāvatā paññattipatho, yāvatā paññā yāvatā paññ'āvacaraṃ, yāvatā vaṭṭaṃ, yāvatā vaṭṭati, tadabhiññāvimutto bhikkhu, tadabhiññāvimuttaṃ bhikkhuṃ na jānāti na passati iti'ssa diṭṭhī'ti, tadakallaṃ.

29781.meaning1: delights in that; takes pleasure in that
29781.commentary: (MNa) tadabhinandatī'ti taṃ cakkhuñ'c'eva rūpañ'ca taṇhādiṭṭhivasena abhinandati. (NIDD1a) tadabhinandatī'ti taṃ ārammaṇaṃ taṇhāvasena abhinandati.

examples.text: iti me cakkhu ahosi atītam'addhānaṃ iti rūpā'ti, tattha chandarāgappaṭibaddhaṃ hoti viññāṇaṃ, chandarāgappaṭibaddhattā viññāṇassa tadabhinandati, tadabhinandanto atītaṃ anvāgameti.

29782.meaning1: delighting in that; taking pleasure in that

examples.text: iti me cakkhu ahosi atītam'addhānaṃ iti rūpā'ti, tattha chandarāgappaṭibaddhaṃ hoti viññāṇaṃ, chandarāgappaṭibaddhattā viññāṇassa tadabhinandati, tadabhinandanto atītaṃ anvāgameti.

29783.meaning1: to approve of that; to be pleased with that; to take delight in that
29783.meaning2: to approve of that; to be pleased with that
29783.commentary: (ITIa) n'ālaṃ tadabhinanditun'ti taṃ upādānakkhandhapañcakaṃ evaṃ paccay'ādhīnavuttikaṃ, tato eva aniccaṃ, dukkhañ'ca taṇhādiṭṭhīhi abhinandituṃ assādetuṃ na yuttaṃ.

examples.text: yo nu kho, ānanda, tañ'ca pajānāti, tassa ca samudayaṃ pajānāti, tassa ca atthaṅ'gamaṃ pajānāti, tassa ca assādaṃ pajānāti, tassa ca ādīnavaṃ pajānāti, tassa ca nissaraṇaṃ pajānāti, kallaṃ nu tena tadabhinanditun'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.
āhāranettippabhavaṃ, n'ālaṃ tadabhinandituṃ, tassa nissaraṇaṃ santaṃ, atakk'āvacaraṃ dhuvaṃ.

29784.meaning1: completely avoids that; shuns that; steers clear of that
29784.commentary: (ANa) tadabhinivattetī'ti taṃ abhinivatteti. yadā vā tena vipāko ñāto hoti vidito, tadā te c'eva dhamme tañ'ca vipākaṃ abhinivatteti.

examples.text: āyatiṃ vipākaṃ viditvā tadabhinivajjeti, tadabhinivajjetvā cetasā abhivirājetvā paññāya ativijjha passati. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, atīte chandarāgaṭṭhāniye dhamme ārabbha chando na jāyati.

29785.meaning1: having completely avoided that; having shunned that; having steered clear of that
29785.commentary: (ANa) iminā ca padena vipassanā kathitā, tadabhinivattetvā'ti iminā maggo.

examples.text: āyatiṃ vipākaṃ viditvā tadabhinivajjeti. tadabhinivajjetvā cetasā abhivirājetvā paññāya ativijjha passati. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, atīte chandarāgaṭṭhāniye dhamme ārabbha chando na jāyati.

29786.meaning1: completely avoids that; shuns that; steers clear of that
29786.commentary: (ANa) tadabhinivattetī'ti taṃ abhinivatteti. yadā vā tena vipāko ñāto hoti vidito, tadā te c'eva dhamme tañ'ca vipākaṃ abhinivatteti.

examples.text: āyatiṃ vipākaṃ viditvā tadabhinivatteti. tadabhinivattetvā cetasā abhinivijjhitvā paññāya ativijjha passati. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, atīte chandarāgaṭṭhāniye dhamme ārabbha chando na jāyati.

29787.meaning1: having completely avoided that; having shunned that; having steered clear of that
29787.commentary: (ANa) iminā ca padena vipassanā kathitā, tadabhinivattetvā'ti iminā maggo.

examples.text: āyatiṃ vipākaṃ viditvā tadabhinivatteti. tadabhinivattetvā cetasā abhinivijjhitvā paññāya ativijjha passati. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, atīte chandarāgaṭṭhāniye dhamme ārabbha chando na jāyati.

yaṃ, bhikkhave, sadevakassa lokassa samārakassa sabrahmakassa sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya idaṃ saccan'ti upanijjhāyitaṃ ta'dam'ariyānaṃ etaṃ musā'ti yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya sudiṭṭhaṃ, ayam'ek'ānupassanā.
tadaminā'pi jānātha, yathāme'daṃ nidassanaṃ, caṇḍālaputto sopāko, mātaṅgo iti vissuto.

29791.meaning1: that just by this; in this (way)

examples.text: saññā nu kho, tadaminā'p'etaṃ, poṭṭhapāda, pariyāyena veditabbaṃ yathā aññā'va saññā bhavissati añño attā.
tadaminā'p'etaṃ, ānanda, pariyāyena veditabbaṃ yathā sakalam'ev'idaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, yadidaṃ, kalyāṇamittatā kalyāṇasahāyatā kalyāṇasampavaṅkatā.

29792.meaning1: that noble person; that ethical man; (or) a noble man (does not talk) like that

examples.text: dubbhāsitaṃ vikkhalitaṃ, sampamohaṃ parājayaṃ, añño'ññass'ābhinandanti, tadariyo katha'n'ācare.
amosadhammaṃ nibbānaṃ, tadariyā saccato vidū, te ve sacc'ābhisamayā, nicchātā parinibbutā'ti.
yaṃ pare sukhato āhu, tadariyā āhu dukkhato, yaṃ pare dukkhato āhu, tadariyā sukhato vidū.

29794.meaning1: that would be; that could be

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, matajaṃ nāma āvudhajātaṃ ubhatodhāraṃ pītanisitaṃ. tadassa saṅghāṭiyā sampārutaṃ sampaliveṭhitaṃ. tath'ūpam'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, imassa bhikkhuno pabbajjaṃ vadāmi.
sabbasāmukkaṃsikaṃ vata me samaṇo gotamo pañhaṃ puṭṭho saṃsādeti, no vissajjeti, na nūna visahatī'ti. tadassa uttiyassa paribbājakassa dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyā'ti.
yaṃ hi'ssa, bhante, vīriyaṃ tadassa vīriy'indriyaṃ.

29796.meaning1: relishes that; takes pleasure in that; likes that

examples.text: so tadassādeti, taṃ nikāmeti, tena ca vittiṃ āpajjati. tattha ṭhito tadadhimutto tabbahulavihārī aparihīno kālaṃ kurumāno brahmakāyikānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjati.

29797.commentary: (DNa) yattha bhummā tadassitā'ti yesu yesu ṭhānesu bhummā devatā taṃ taṃ nissitā.

examples.text: silokam'anukassāmi, yattha bhummā tadassitā, ye sitā girigabbharaṃ, pahit'attā samāhitā.

29798.meaning2: having the manifestation of concealing those (good qualities)

29799.meaning1: went there; wandered there; arrived there

examples.text: so kho ahaṃ, bhikkhave, kiṃ kusalagavesī anuttaraṃ santivarapadaṃ pariyesamāno magadhesu anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena uruvelā senānigamo tadavasariṃ.
evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā mallesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena thūṇaṃ nāma mallānaṃ brāhmaṇagāmo tadavasari.
